name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain 'animate' matches the animation-family siblings (fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_in/out), descriptor 'spell_hit_cinematic' accurately names the spell-HIT cinematic sub-loop. No Ghidra address residue. Verified against disasm 0x2BA22-0x2BC98 and the sole caller (fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence) call site.
purpose: 9-frame spell-HIT cinematic sub-loop that brackets one AoE target's hit moment inside the basic-spell cast sequence: Phase 1 slides the caster sprite IN (zoom-in, frame 1..4), Phase 2 slides the next target's hit-effect sprite OUT (zoom-out, frame 4..0).
logic_summary: Setup: workspace_ptr = base_workspace_offset + 0x49C0; pose_count = *(byte*)spell_sprite_atlas; team_dir_sign = runtime_char[attacker_idx].team==0 ? +1 : -1 (enemy casters slide in from right, players from left); flicker_toggle = 0 (shared across both phases). Each phase loops the same per-frame body: (1) if spell_type_idx is 3 or 7 (electric/lightning) toggle flicker and set flicker_dst = workspace_ptr - flicker_toggle*0x280 (1-row jitter), else flicker_dst = workspace_ptr; blit background (bg_workbuf -> flicker_dst, 0x280 stride). (2) pre-blit per-element palette-flash dispatch table[spell_type_idx](attacker_idx, dispatch_sprite_atlas, workspace_ptr, 0x280, 4) (int return ignored). (3) blit spell top-half pose (spell_sprite_atlas, pose_count-1). (4) blit the sliding sprite at frame*0x23*team_dir_sign px (Phase 1: caster_sprite_atlas; Phase 2: hit_effect_sprite). (5) post-blit dispatch table[spell_type_idx](..., 5). (6) push workspace to mode13h primary 0xA0000. (7) wait 1 BIOS tick. Frame count is fixed 4+5 (dispatch return discarded).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_animate_spell_hit_cinematic(uint32 attacker_idx, uint32 dispatch_sprite_atlas, uint32 spell_sprite_atlas, int caster_sprite_atlas, uint32 base_workspace_offset, uint32 bg_workbuf, int hit_effect_sprite, int spell_type_idx)

params.name: dispatch_sprite_atlas
params.semantics: FDOTHER.DAT team-caster effect sprite handle (caller's team_caster_sprite); passed as arg1 (sprite_atlas) to the per-element palette-flash dispatch table entry both before and after the per-frame sprite blits.

params.name: spell_sprite_atlas
params.semantics: Caster's spell-animation FIGANI atlas (caller's caster_figani_b); its first byte is the pose count, and pose (pose_count-1) is blit as the top-half spell pose every frame.

params.semantics: Current target's FIGANI atlas (caller's figani_buf[target_iter]); used ONLY in Phase 1 as the zoom-IN sliding sprite (pose 0) at frame*0x23*team_dir_sign.
params.reason: Accurate, address-residue-free; matches caller arg figani_buf[target_iter]. (Live Ghidra display happens to show 'caster_idx' here, but that is a decompiler mislabel; the value is a sprite atlas, not an index.)

params.name: bg_workbuf
params.semantics: 64000-byte mode13h backbuffer holding the static battle background (caller's backbuf); blit as the per-frame background composite source (stride 0x140) into flicker_dst.

params.name: hit_effect_sprite
params.semantics: NEXT target's FIGANI atlas (caller's figani_buf[target_iter+1]); used ONLY in Phase 2 as the zoom-OUT sliding sprite (pose 0), reversing Phase 1's slide-in.
params.reason: Accurate, address-residue-free; matches caller arg figani_buf[target_iter+1]. (Live Ghidra mislabels 'pHit_sprite'.)

params.name: spell_type_idx
params.semantics: Spell id (caller's spell_id); selects the palette-flash dispatch table entry data_fd2_battle_spell_cast_cinematic_phase_handler_table[spell_type_idx], and gates the electric/lightning flicker (==3 || ==7).
